default.description: Patch: adult thin BLACK stick torso/arms/legs, pure WHITE perfectly round head, tiny black oval eyes, simple tiny line or small reaction mouth, orange bandage above anatomical RIGHT eye (viewer LEFT frontal), WHITE mitten hands and WHITE oval feet. No hair, nose, ears, eyebrows or filled torso.

Reed: adult thin BLACK stick torso/arms/legs, pure WHITE perfectly round head, tiny black oval eyes, tiny mouth, small blue-gray scarf, WHITE mitten hands and WHITE oval feet. NO bandage. Separate GRAY school backpack stands on FLOOR when stationary, no straps on body; carries only by top handle with real white mitten contact when explicit action requires it. No hair/nose/ears/eyebrows or filled torso.

Mara: adult thin BLACK stick torso/limbs, round pure WHITE head, small black oval eyes and tiny mouth, WHITE mittens/oval feet. ONE purple identification band on anatomical RIGHT forearm (viewer LEFT frontal), NO orange bandage or scarf. Separate TEAL school pack on FLOOR, or visible top-handle grip only when carrying. Keep proportions identical to her reference.

Cart Infected: adult thin black stick limbs, round pale desaturated GREEN #A8BE87 head, both GREEN mitten hands and both GREEN oval feet, small black oval eyes/short mouth, olive-gray ragged vest. No hero bandage/scarf/pack, no white infected skin, no hair/realistic face or gore.

Delivery Infected: adult thin black stick limbs, round pale desaturated GREEN #A8BE87 head, both GREEN mittens and both GREEN oval feet, small black oval eyes/short mouth, dusty navy vest with two pockets. No orange bandage/hero pack/scarf, no hair/realistic face/gore. Distinct from olive Cart Infected.

Surveyor: ONE nonhuman mint round head with TWO large dark oval eyes and short mouth, compact charcoal-gray covered torso, thin black limbs, mint mitten hands, dark oval boots. ONE blue stripe on anatomical RIGHT shoulder (viewer LEFT frontal) and a small gray scanner. No scarf, bandage, pack or human white skin. Same alien every appearance, not a second visitor from reference.

Worker: ONE nonhuman pale mint round head with two large dark oval eyes/short mouth, compact gray torso, thin black limbs, mint mittens/dark oval boots. NO blue shoulder stripe, scanner, scarf, bandage or pack. Distinct from Surveyor, never draw duplicates.
